description: Build a weekly client report from the same inputs as create_weekly_report and return it as plain text (header, accomplishments, hours, blockers, next week) ready to paste into an email or chat. Use when the user wants a readable report to send. Do NOT use when structured fields are needed; use create_weekly_report.

accomplishments.description: What was done this week, one short item per entry (at least one), e.g. ["Shipped login", "Fixed 3 bugs"]

blockers.description: Open issues blocking progress, one per entry, e.g. ["Waiting on API review"]. Default none.

client_name.description: Client the report is for, e.g. "Globex"

hours_logged.description: Total hours worked this week, >= 0, e.g. 32. Omit if not tracked.

next_week.description: Planned tasks for next week, one per entry. Default none.

week_start.description: First day of the reported week, YYYY-MM-DD (normally the Monday; use week_bounds to find it), e.g. 2026-09-28. The week ends 6 days later.

name: render_report_text

text.description: The weekly report rendered as multi-line plain text.

title: Render report text
